john1.1.p1.b1.text: That which was from the beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen with our own eyes, which we have gazed upon and touched with our own hands—this is the Word of life.

john1.1.p1.b2.text: And this is the life that was revealed; we have seen it … and we proclaim to you the eternal life that was with the Father and was revealed to us.

john1.1.p2.b1.text: We proclaim to you what we have seen and heard, so that you also may have fellowship with us.

john1.1.p2.b2.text: We write these things so that our joy may be complete.

john1.1.p2.b3.text: God is light, and in Him there is no darkness at all.

john1.1.p2.b4.text: If we say we have fellowship with Him yet walk in the darkness, we lie and do not practice the truth.

john1.1.p3.b1.text: But if we walk in the light as He is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, …

john1.1.p3.b2.text: If we say we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.

john1.1.p3.b3.text: If we confess our sins, He is faithful and just to forgive us our sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

john1.1.p3.b4.text: If we say we have not sinned, we make Him out to be a liar, and His word is not in us.
